colleges.notes: One tuition column 'Indian Students' — no split by quota; repeated for the three seat types our roster lists (Punjab Domicile / Adesh IP / Open AI basis). Year-wise: group (a) 16,90,000 → 18,59,000 → 20,45,900; group (b) 7,00,000 → 7,70,000 → 8,47,000. Also: Development Charges Rs. 95,000/- (Per Year); University Registration Charges Rs. 2,10,000 (One Time); College Securities Rs. 50,000 (refundable/adjustable); Library Securities Rs. 35,000; Hostel Securities Rs. 30,000; Examination Rs. 22,100 per chance; Thesis Rs. 35,000; enrolment fee Rs. 20,000 (SC 15,000) + medical exam Rs. 8,000. §13.4 'THE MANAGEMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO REVISE ALL FEE'. Bond Rs. 25 lakh with 18% interest for not serving one year as Senior Resident. No NRI fee printed (roster has no Adesh NRI quota). Prospectus dated 23 Jun 2026 (file Last-Modified). BFUHS prospectus §NRI says the 15% registration fee does not apply to Adesh/SGRD.

Applies to GMC Amritsar (87), GMC Patiala (64), GGS Medical College Faridkot (188), Dr BR Ambedkar SIMS Mohali (1780). NSNIS Patiala has its own PGDSM row (see colleges). Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospitals New Chandigarh (112) and Sangrur (714) are government (TMC) hospitals but are not named — see not_published.

government_all.notes: Six-month (first-instalment) amounts as printed; per-year amount not printed — do not double. Note 2: 'The fee indicated above represents the minimum amount payable at the time of provisional admission and is subject to the applicable fee structure notified by the Government of Punjab from time to time.' Pathology is listed under 'Clinical'. AIQ seats are not covered (state counselling prospectus). Same table's 'Private Colleges Six month fee' columns (Govt. Quota 137500 basic / 342500 clinical / 205000 diploma; Mgt. Quota same; NRI Quota 1st instalment US$ 10000 / 65000 / 15000) and the NRI table on printed p.17 (Total Course Fee (Lump Sum) US$ 1,25,000 clinical, 20,000 basic, 30,000 PG Diploma) are the counselling authority's tables for private colleges — NOT used (owner's rule). Security deposit for subsequent rounds: Govt colleges Rs. 25,000 (SC/BC/PwBD 10,000), private Rs. 2,00,000. HSLIBNET fee MD/MS Rs. 9000.
